scope: Existing five-document plan, finite local implementation and simulations; real external gates retained.

items.title: Core phases 0–8, bounded phase 10 and minimal SecOps UI
acceptance: Retain accepted local source/runtime/browser evidence; do not rerun unchanged campaigns.

items.title: Bounded SourceCoverage history/intake/corrections/pruning/scans
acceptance: Retain validated finite history and ownership contracts; live observers are separate.

items.title: CloudTrail normalization/profile and initial receipt store
acceptance: Preserve original/prepared bytes and initial synced control, bounded worker and exclusive owner.

items.title: Atomic verified-prefix progress and immutable suffix replay
acceptance: Share the existing admission verifier; full binding/owner/exact prior-control comparison.
Bounded atomic replace + file/directory sync; verify partial/uncertain responses, stale updates, timeout/cancel/queue/crash/reopen.
Never infer source ACK or protected custody from M2.

items.title: Retirement, owner takeover and restore reconciliation
acceptance: Qualify retention guards, intent/unlink/sync/complete and new-slot publication.
Exclusive lock plus generation fencing; divergent or unknown restore holds side effects; bounded crash/fault matrix.
items.notes: Handover, checkpoint-gated restore opening, bounded retirement/reclamation and explicit new UUID slot replacement accepted locally. Fresh independent checkpoint authentication remains application-owned; unknown temp/orphan states hold. No stronger custody or remote fencing.

items.title: Source acknowledgement and selected custody seam
acceptance: Durable intent before delete, fresh delivery handle/authority, uncertainty/redelivery preserve preparation.
Explicit process-only vs independently verified custody; quarantine and revoked-grant denials.
items.notes: Explicit process-local ACK intent/result/uncertain mechanism accepted with 436 workspace tests and independent source review. No handle persistence, networking, stronger custody or quarantine ACK. Adapter authentication/freshness and independent checkpoint continuity remain trusted application duties.

items.title: Bounded CloudTrail gzip object reader/preparation
acceptance: Bound compressed/decoded bytes, records and spans before allocation; verify exact record hashes/native IDs.
Atomic all-ordinal preparation and quarantine; expansion/malformed/duplicate/truncated fixtures.
items.notes: Complete bounded gzip/span reader and pinned deterministic receipt preparation accepted locally with 461 workspace tests and independent review. Original-only quarantine, aggregate output cap, timestamp instant pins and exact replay qualify; no transport/source authority or stronger custody.

items.title: CloudTrail S3/SQS collector and local delivery simulation
acceptance: End-to-end source to receipt to M2 replay with duplicates, throttling, visibility expiry, denied scope and checkpoint recovery.
No credentials/private topology in public core; original versions retained.
items.notes: Direct discovery and bounded stream capture/owned preparation accepted with 477 workspace tests and independent review. Actual network collector/queue/source ACK simulation remains runnable; auth/provider deployment and stronger custody unqualified.

items.title: Source observers, health and SDK/server integration
acceptance: Independent expected-stream/config/last-observed/checkpoint/gap observations and visible degraded silence.
Bound observer state; live evidence not inferred from collector success.

items.title: Durable public findings cursor runtime
acceptance: Versioned bounded feed, stable cursor/identity, restart/duplicate/divergent-history tests.

items.title: Private transactional finding cursor/outbox and notification simulation
acceptance: Atomic cursor/outbox advancement; destination retries, uncertain response, duplicate identity, quotas and restart.
Keep destination policy/private data in separately authorized writable overlay.

items.title: Disposition/outcome backend seam
acceptance: Persist audited true/benign/false positive and incident outcomes with stable finding references and scope checks.

items.title: Independent protected original route and validation simulation
acceptance: Full source/proof/version/retention binding, separate authority and restricted access.
Observability-plane outage, proof failure and recovery tests; local proof never certifies Object Lock/IAM.

items.title: Object-backed Parquet and committed query manifests
acceptance: Bounded idempotent object publication, committed manifests, pruning/query/restart and orphan recovery.
Source originals distinct from query copies; PUT alone is not committed custody.

items.title: Selective query acceleration, retention and cost controls
acceptance: Explicit raw/query retention and safe reachability-aware reclamation; partition/projection pruning and scan budgets.
Caches rebuildable; measure before adding optional field index; protected originals not deleted by query policy.

items.title: OIDC/trusted identity, scoped credentials and RBAC
acceptance: Local identity-provider simulation; no identity-header bypass, expiry/revocation and cross-scope denials on ingest/query/evidence/findings/admin.

items.title: mTLS and credential/certificate rotation
acceptance: Local TLS endpoints; failed chain/rotation/revocation tests and outbound-only agents; bounded network budgets.

items.title: Restricted independent audit and secrets/encryption integration seams
acceptance: Audit access/config/rule/admin changes to separate destination; outage health independent of failed plane.
Local secret/rotation/restore and encrypted-storage configuration checks; never log secrets.

items.title: Small source→evidence→finding→notification simulation
acceptance: One reproducible installation and full replay/restart/denial/outage run with preserved evidence and actual counts.

items.title: PostgreSQL shared-control schema, transactions, fencing and migration contract
acceptance: Freeze bounded receipt/catalog/state/ownership schemas and separate engine/private roles; explicit migration and restore contract.

items.title: Shared-control implementation and local PostgreSQL qualification
acceptance: Transactional monotonically fenced partition ownership, stale-owner rejection, manifest/checkpoint/outbox coherence and bounded metadata.

items.title: Versioned object-backed custody receipt
acceptance: Accessible retained object plus committed idempotent owner-checked control; producer retains copy until verified custody.
202 remains M2; crash/uncertainty/duplicate ownership tests.

items.title: Standard ownership, failover and consistent restore simulation
acceptance: Controlled one-server/domain loss and stale owners, consistent objects/control backup and restore.
Measure recovery/RPO in stated local model; no automatic three-replica change before gates.

items.title: Secure scoped onboarding and coverage/detection activation
acceptance: Connected/verified coverage/active detections states; missing permissions/categories/state visibly block unsupported detections.

items.title: Bounded CloudWatch managed-log intake
acceptance: Native push/bulk intake simulation with checkpoints, exact originals and declared coverage; RDS/EKS-control/ECS profiles remain explicit.

items.title: AWS RDS/ALB/NLB/ECS/VPC/DNS/WAF/security-event profiles
acceptance: Implement only sources selected by existing ingestion plan/catalog; raw positives/negatives/missing/duplicates normalize consistently.
Each source has explicit delivery/coverage preconditions; synthetic samples alone are insufficient.

items.title: EKS/Kubernetes audit adapter
acceptance: Audit-stage/verb/resource/identity normalization and baseline D05/D07 fixtures; separate control-plane capture from node logs.

items.title: Node/workload context and cluster collector mode
acceptance: Bounded metadata/watch reconciliation and node-local collection; scoped API permissions and churn tests on local Kubernetes.

items.title: Selected host/runtime and authentication source profiles
acceptance: Explicit sensor coverage and authentication fields; no runtime-security claims from file logs alone.

items.title: Site TCP/TLS syslog and FortiGate normalization
acceptance: Bounded framing/source identity/local spool, WAN outage replay and severity fixtures; legacy UDP explicitly best effort.

items.title: Selected Microsoft 365 audit/authentication API feeds
acceptance: Finite paged API checkpoints, token refresh, 429/outage/retry/dedup and declared feed coverage; local provider simulation.

items.title: Cato API event collection
acceptance: Bounded pagination/checkpoints/security normalization and provider-specific replay/retention failures; local simulation.

items.title: Cloudflare object-delivery normalization
acceptance: Reuse bounded object intake; pin selected schema/coverage and positive/negative/malformed fixtures.

items.title: Versioned generic baseline predicate packs
acceptance: D01/D02/D03/D05/D07 source preconditions, fixtures, explanation/confidence/investigation defaults; actual enablement/thresholds stay private.

items.title: First bounded window detector D10
acceptance: Finite key/event/byte/TTL bounds, event-time/watermark/lateness/overflow and replay; atomic state/finding/checkpoint recovery.

items.title: Scoped state lookup detectors D04/D06/D08/D09/D12/D13
acceptance: Each supported rule has source/state preconditions, pinned revision and bounded fixtures/replay.
Effective IAM/RBAC requires explicitly limited semantics, not universal permission solving.

items.title: Independent missing-telemetry detector D15
acceptance: Independent observer, no healthy silence on gaps; bounded heartbeat/lateness/failure-path evidence.

items.title: Bounded multi-stream episodes D11/D14
acceptance: One join/episode at a time; late/duplicate/missing streams, bounded state, crash recovery, stable evidence/incident identities.
Correlation does not establish causal root cause.

items.title: Planned advanced SOC case/disposition/workbench workflows
acceptance: Bounded persisted case/assignment/disposition/evidence views with audited permissions and actual browser/restart tests.
Response automation stays explicit opt-in; no broad new SOAR platform.

items.title: Resource/profile and controlled-outage qualification
acceptance: Workload manifests with bytes/cardinality/rules/query/steady/burst/latency/RSS/catch-up evidence.
Agent 30-minute budgets and finite 15-minute/1-hour/4-hour outage campaigns; 24-hour steady campaign if local resources permit.
Unsupported scale claims remain visibly unqualified; do not fake native measurements.

items.title: Measured Scale profile worker-separation decision
acceptance: Record contention/permission/recovery evidence; separate workers only if measurements justify it.
No split required if evidence does not justify it; decision must be documented.

items.title: Current-revision local Kubernetes persistence/restart gate
acceptance: Repair only owned/local resource preconditions; pass chart PVC/persistence/restart using qualified current image.

items.title: Independent source review and resolve findings
acceptance: Review durability/replay/cancellation/scope/quotas and production hazards; retain review evidence per accepted slice.

items.title: SBOM, provenance and signed release/rule verification
acceptance: Reproducible inventory/provenance and local test-key sign/verify/tamper/rejection; real publication credentials excluded.

items.title: Supported migration/rollback/restore local rehearsals
acceptance: Explicit version/state compatibility and consistent restore; fail closed on incompatible or divergent history.

items.title: Final current-revision local release candidate
acceptance: Applicable fmt/strict Clippy/workspace/boundary/process/browser/container/supply-chain gates pass.
Source/config/image/evidence hashes aligned; offline relocation/package verification, SBOM and release notes retained.
Version remains owner-controlled; local candidate explicitly not full production release.

items.title: Native ARM64 qualification
acceptance: Actual native build/runtime/container/Kubernetes/load evidence.

items.title: Actual AWS/EKS/storage/IAM/KMS/Object Lock qualification
acceptance: Authorized real cloud source/deployment/identity/storage/protected-retention and restart evidence.

items.title: Live SaaS/network-provider qualification
acceptance: Authorized actual feeds, feed coverage/permissions/retention and source-capture evidence.

items.title: Remote CI for reviewed revision
acceptance: Required remote native jobs and retained artifacts matching reviewed revision.

items.title: Private overlay against actual released public dependency
acceptance: Real released version and locked external graph build/runtime evidence.

items.title: Owner-directed version, publication and main merge
acceptance: Required external gates passed and publication/push/main merge authority; production signing keys remain owner-held.
